Arachnids_enemy attribution
===========================

The integrated Arachnid units, spawner, bosses, animations, effects, graphics
and sounds are adapted from "Arachnids on normal enemy force"
(Arachnids_enemy) 1.2.0 by MFerrari:

https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Arachnids_enemy

The Factorio Mod Portal declares Arachnids_enemy to be licensed under the MIT
License. Its downloadable 1.2.0 archive did not include a LICENSE or NOTICE
file, so the standard MIT text is reproduced beside this notice as
Arachnids_enemy-MIT.txt.

Arachnids_enemy is itself based on the MIT-licensed "Arachnids" by Aotenshin
and "ArachnidsFaction" by MnHebi. The creature animation/rig is credited by
those projects to Sobigdrasil:

https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Arachnids
https://mods.factorio.com/mod/ArachnidsFaction

The Cave 3.1.50 modifies the upstream package by removing terrain autoplace and
its runtime terrain-check setting, moving its data-stage code and assets into
The Cave, disabling standalone spawner autoplace, adding deterministic scripted
room and direct-dig spawning, adding zone-scaled boss selection, and extending
English/Russian locale entries. No upstream control-stage code is included.

The Cave maintainer reports receiving explicit permission from MFerrari to
integrate this work. Distribution of these files does not depend on that
private statement because the upstream projects are publicly MIT-licensed.

MFerrari, Aotenshin, MnHebi and Sobigdrasil do not endorse or support The Cave.
